meta.promptText: Which moisturizer should I buy for dry skin in Indian winters?

response.text:
During Indian winters, dropping temperatures and dry winds strip moisture from the skin, often causing flakiness, tightness, and a compromised skin barrier.[www.mrmed.in](https://www.mrmed.in/health-library/skin-care/best-moisturizers-for-winter-india#:~:text=Table_title%3A%20Winter%20Skin%20Across%20Different%20Regions%20of,becomes%20the%20best%20moisturizer%20for%20winter%20season.) To combat this, you need a nourishing cream packed with barrier-repairing ingredients like **ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and rich plant oils**.[www.mrmed.in](https://www.mrmed.in/health-library/skin-care/best-moisturizers-for-winter-india#:~:text=*%20Ceramides%20%E2%80%93%20strengthen%20skin%20barrier.%20*,deeper%2C%20longer-lasting%20hydration%20compared%20to%20gel-based%20moisturisers.)

Top-rated options tailored for dry skin in Indian winters include:

The CeraVe Cream offers **intense 24-hour hydration** using three essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid to repair dry barriers.

The Cetaphil Moisturising Cream provides **long-lasting 48-hour moisture** enriched with sweet almond oil, niacinamide, and panthenol to soothe winter sensitivity.

The Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser features a rich formula that **prevents trans-epidermal water loss** and relieves dry, itchy skin.

The Minimalist 5% Marula Oil Face Moisturizer For Dry Skin combines **5% pure Marula oil with Vitamins F and E** to deeply nourish rough, flaky winter skin.

The Dot & Key Ceramides & Hyaluronic Barrier Repair Moisturizer delivers **budget-friendly barrier repair** using five essential ceramides, Japanese rice water, and probiotics.

The Himalaya Winter Defense Moisturizing Cream is an **affordable, classic option** infused with almond and wheat germ oils to lock in winter moisture.
